query_text: Find the best deals for laptops online.

parts.text:
The early summer shopping season is in full effect. Because Amazon has moved up **Prime Day 2026 to June 23–26**, rival retailers like Best Buy and Dell have launched aggressive counter-sales early. 

The best online laptop deals across budget, productivity, macOS, and gaming categories include the following offers:

---

### **Best Everyday & Productivity Laptops**
*   **Samsung Galaxy Book Pro 360 (15.6-inch)**
    *   **The Deal:** **$1,199.99** (Save $150 off $1,349.99) at [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com).
    *   **Specs:** Intel Core Ultra 7 256V processor, 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD, Super AMOLED touchscreen. 
    *   **Why buy:** It is a super-thin 2-in-1 convertible (weighing just 3 pounds) that comes with an S Pen stylus. Its AMOLED display has incredible contrast, making it perfect for creative work.
*   **Lenovo ThinkPad E16 (Gen 3)**
    *   **The Deal:** **$1,289.00** (Save $510 off $1,799.00) at [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com).
    *   **Specs:** 16-inch 1200p display, Intel Core Ultra 7 255H processor, 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD.
    *   **Why buy:** Renowned for durability and having one of the best keyboards on any laptop, this ThinkPad has a bright, anti-glare display and robust security features, making it an excellent high-performance workhorse.
*   **Dell 14 Laptop (DC14250)**
    *   **The Deal:** **$699.99** (Save ~14% off MSRP) at [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com).
    *   **Specs:** 14.0-inch 2K Anti-Glare IPS display, Intel Core 7 150U processor, 16GB RAM, 1TB SSD.
    *   **Why buy:** A sleek, mid-range laptop featuring a sharp 2K display, fingerprint reader, backlit keyboard, and a spacious 1TB SSD.

---

### **Best MacBook Deals**
*   **Apple MacBook Air 15-inch (M5)**
    *   **The Deal:** **$1,149.00** (Save $150 off $1,299.00) at [Best Buy](https://www.bestbuy.com) or [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com).
    *   **Specs:** Apple M5 chip, 16GB unified memory, 512GB SSD.
    *   **Why buy:** This is Apple's newest generation ultraportable. The M5 processor handles heavy multitasking with ease, while the 15-inch display is ideal for those who want screen real estate without the weight of a MacBook Pro.
*   **Apple MacBook Air 13-inch (M4)**
    *   **The Deal:** **$1,099.00** (Save $300 off $1,399.00) at [Best Buy](https://www.bestbuy.com).
    *   **Specs:** Apple M4 chip, 24GB unified memory, 512GB SSD.
    *   **Why buy:** While it features the previous-generation M4 chip, this deal is highly recommended because it is configured with **24GB of RAM**. It is incredibly fast and future-proofed for local AI workloads. 
*   **Apple MacBook Pro 14-inch (M4 Pro)**
    *   **The Deal:** **$1,799.00** (Save $200 off $1,999.00) at [Best Buy](https://www.bestbuy.com).
    *   **Specs:** M4 Pro chip, 14.2-inch Liquid Retina XDR display, 24GB unified memory, 512GB SSD.
    *   **Why buy:** Designed for creators and power users who need high-bandwidth processing, exceptional graphics performance, and premium displays.

---

### **Best Budget Deals (Under $400)**
*   **Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3i**
    *   **The Deal:** **$279.99** (Save $170 off $449.99) at [Best Buy](https://www.bestbuy.com).
    *   **Specs:** Intel Core i3, 8GB RAM, 256GB SSD.
    *   **Why buy:** A highly reliable entry-level machine that easily covers basic needs like streaming, web browsing, and Microsoft Office tasks. 
*   **Acer Chromebook 315 (15.6-inch)**
    *   **The Deal:** **$149.00** (Save $150 off $299.00) at [Best Buy](https://www.bestbuy.com).
    *   **Specs:** Intel Celeron N4500, 4GB RAM, 64GB eMMC.
    *   **Why buy:** If you just need a secondary computer, a basic machine for a young student, or something to write documents on, this is one of the most affordable 15.6-inch laptops you can buy.

---

### **Best Gaming Laptops**
*   **Acer Predator Helios Neo 16**
    *   **The Deal:** **$1,909.00** (Save $290 off $2,199.00) at [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com).
    *   **Specs:** High-refresh-rate display, powerful Intel Core i9 processor, NVIDIA RTX graphics. 
    *   **Why buy:** Excellent cooling, robust chassis, and top-tier frame rates for gamers who don't want to compromise on screen size or thermal performance.

---

### **Quick Laptop Buying Tips**
1.  **Look for Copilot+ AI Baselines:** If you are buying a mid-range or premium Windows laptop, prioritize processors with dedicated NPUs (like the Snapdragon X Elite/Plus, Intel Core Ultra, or AMD Ryzen AI chips). These chips enable 20+ hours of battery life and support offline AI capabilities.
2.  **Aim for at least 16GB of RAM:** Operating systems and modern background tasks (especially AI integrations) run significantly better on 16GB than 8GB. 
3.  **Timing Your Purchase:** While these early June deals are strong, **Amazon Prime Day (June 23–26)** might yield even deeper price cuts on MacBooks and entry-level Chromebooks. If you can wait a couple of weeks, prices on certain models (like the base-tier MacBook Air) may drop by another $50 to $100.
